diff --git a/index.mjs b/index.mjs
index 4bff70b..49b5415 100644
--- a/index.mjs
+++ b/index.mjs
@@ -1 +1 @@
-export { slugify } from './lib/slug.mjs'
+export { slugify, uniqueSlug } from './lib/slug.mjs'
diff --git a/lib/slug.mjs b/lib/slug.mjs
index 30c170b..30c5b31 100644
--- a/lib/slug.mjs
+++ b/lib/slug.mjs
@@ -1,3 +1,16 @@
 export function slugify(input) {
-  throw new Error('slugify is not implemented yet')
+  return String(input)
+    .normalize('NFD')
+    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
+    .toLowerCase()
+    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
+    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
+}
+
+export function uniqueSlug(base, existing) {
+  const taken = new Set(existing)
+  if (!taken.has(base)) return base
+  let n = 2
+  while (taken.has(`${base}-${n}`)) n++
+  return `${base}-${n}`
 }

All 4 tests pass. Here's what I implemented:

**`lib/slug.mjs`** — the missing feature:
- `slugify(input)` — normalizes Unicode (NFD) and strips combining diacritics to remove accents, lowercases, replaces any run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single `-` (which collapses repeated separators and trims leading/trailing ones), and returns the result.
- `uniqueSlug(base, existing)` — returns `base` if unused; otherwise scans for the smallest suffix `n >= 2` such that `` `${base}-${n}` `` isn't in the existing set.

**`index.mjs`** — added `uniqueSlug` to the export so the test's named import resolves.

Verification with `node --test`: 4 passed, 0 failed.
